name: Enlarge Channel (Meta-Channeling)
body:
You have learned to increase the range of your channeled energies.

Prerequisite(s): Channel energy class feature.

Benefit(s): At the cost of one additional use of channeling energy, you can increase the range of your channeling by 5 feet. You may spend more than one additional use of channeling energy to stack this effect with itself. You may use up to a maximum of three additional uses of channeling energy to increase the range of your channeling up to an additional 15 feet.
